title: Dream with AI: Interactive Bedtime Stories
description: Unlock a world of imagination where your child's choices shape the story. AI-driven personalized storytelling for magical nights.

stages.title: Once Upon a Time
stages.content: Deep in the Whispering Woods, a little owl named Ollie found a glowing key. What should he do next?

stages.title: The Golden Gate
stages.content: A huge gate appeared with three riddles. AI helps your child solve them to proceed, teaching logic and patience.
stages.interaction: Tap the gate to hear the riddle.

stages.title: A Friendly Dragon
stages.content: Ollie met a dragon made of clouds! Instead of fire, it breathed colorful bubbles. Your choice matters: climb up or share a song?

stages.title: The Starry Reward
stages.content: Because you were brave and kind, the forest turned into a sea of stars. This is how AI creates unique rewards for every child.

stages.title: Your Child's Story
stages.content: With eduNest, every bedtime is a new adventure. No more repeated books—just infinite wonder.

parent_guidance: Honey, if you were Ollie, would you open that secret door or look for a friend first?
The gate is asking a question... can you think of something that is round like a ball but can't bounce?
Look at the cloud dragon! He looks very gentle. Shall we sing a song together for him?
You did it! The stars are shining just for you because you helped Ollie. You're a great explorer.
Tonight's story was special because you were part of it. Sleep tight, my little storyteller.
